topic: The planet where it rains glass, sideways

post.caption:
On HD 189733b the rain is molten glass and it never falls down. The winds are so fast it flies sideways.

One science fact a day. Follow so you don't miss tomorrow's.

#exoplanet #space #astronomy #science #planets #hd189733b #spacefacts #alienworlds #universe #didyouknow

subject_anchor: distant planets orbiting other stars: alien worlds, orbits, star charts and the night sky
style_lock: photorealistic studio product photograph of a real physical object on a clean seamless pure white #FFFFFF background, soft even studio light, accurate materials and weight, only a light contact shadow beneath the object, no environment and no gradient; composited with one small flat hand-drawn anime mascot character standing in the scene: a solid matte black bean-shaped body about one tenth of the frame height, two small white dot eyes, thin simple stick arms and legs, slightly irregular hand-drawn outline, calm deadpan expression with no mouth, no clothing; a few small colour accents only, blue or yellow tape, a small green or red dot; generous empty white space, vertical portrait composition

beats.text: On one planet, the rain is molten glass, and it falls sideways.
beats.image_prompt: a real umbrella turned fully on its side and held horizontally, the mascot braced behind it with both arms as sharp glass shards streak past

beats.text: From far away it looks like a calm blue marble, almost like Earth.
beats.image_prompt: one glossy deep blue glass marble on a white surface, the mascot polishing its curve with a small cloth held in both arms

beats.text: But that blue is not ocean. It is a sky full of tiny glass grains.
beats.image_prompt: a clear glass jar tipped over and spilling fine blue glass grit, the mascot cupping both arms under the stream to catch it

beats.text: Winds there move faster than a rifle bullet, so nothing ever falls straight down.
beats.image_prompt: a chrome desk fan running at full speed, the mascot gripping its wire guard with both arms and streaming out sideways like a flag

beats.text: And it is not even the strangest world we have found.
beats.image_prompt: a shallow wooden specimen drawer pulled open on a white surface, the mascot climbing headfirst into it to reach a rock at the very back

beats.text: One planet hugs its star so tightly that a year there lasts a few hours.
beats.image_prompt: a brass kitchen egg timer mid tick, the mascot hanging off its dial with both arms and its feet off the ground, trying to slow it

beats.text: Another may be built around a core of crystallised carbon.
beats.image_prompt: a grey rock cracked open to show a bright cut diamond inside, the mascot levering the two halves apart with a small crowbar

beats.text: One is being eaten alive, stretched into a glowing tail like a comet.
beats.image_prompt: a ball of pale wool unravelling into one long trailing thread, the mascot hauling back on the loose end with both arms and losing

beats.text: We have now confirmed more than five thousand planets around other stars.
beats.image_prompt: a wide flat tray packed edge to edge with hundreds of small round marbles, the mascot pressing one last marble into the only gap left

beats.text: Almost none of them look anything like our neighbourhood.
beats.image_prompt: a wooden shape sorter toy, the mascot shoving a lumpy uneven rock against the neat round hole with both arms as it refuses to fit

beats.text: Out there, glass rain is ordinary. We are the strange ones.
beats.image_prompt: a glass display dome on a low white plinth with one small blue and green marble beneath it, the mascot lifting the heavy dome off with both arms

beats.text: But you do not have to leave home for strange. Look at Venus.
beats.image_prompt: a pale yellow white ball the size of a grapefruit on a white surface, the mascot leaning its whole body against it to push it rolling backwards
